name: Beauty Farm Medical and Health Industry Inc.
summary: Beauty Farm Medical and Health Industry Inc. provides beauty and health management services in the People's Republic of China. It offers aesthetic medical, and subhealth assessment medical services; and intervention services. The company markets its products under the Beauty Farm, Palaispa, Neology, and CellCare brand names. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
